notes: #5 was printed from two plates; a faint vertical join runs just right of the center cartouche (not a book gutter). The Braun and Hogenberg Leeuwarden plates (#1–#4, #6) are bird’s-eye plans, mostly shared with Franeker; #5 is the better P1 view. #12 (1849 colored lithograph from the northwest) is a good alternative but sits nine years from #20, so #14 (1754) was used to fill the 18th century. #22/#23 are the same gasholder aerial; #21 is farmland.
